title: Turtle Beach Corporation to Report First Quarter 2026 Financial Results on Thursday, May 7, 2026
summary: SAN DIEGO, April 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Turtle Beach Corporation (Nasdaq: TBCH) a leading gaming accessories brand, today announced it will report financial results for the first quarter 2026 on Thursday, May 7, 2026, after the close of trading on the Nasdaq Stock Market. The Company will also host a conference call and audio webcast at 4:30p.m. ET / 1:30p.m. PT that same day to review the results. The call will be hosted by Cris Keirn, Chief Executive Officer, and Mark Weinswig, Chief Financial Officer. Conference Call Information The live webcast of the call will be available on the “Events Presentations” page of the Company’s website at corp.turtlebeach.com . Interested individuals may also join by dialing 1-877-407-0792 or 1-201-689-8263. To avoid delays, participants are encouraged to dial into the conference call 15-minutes ahead of the scheduled start time.
